summary:
I have identified and fixed the bug! 

The issue was that `CsvReader.java` was reading the `customers.csv` file using the `ISO-8859-1` character set instead of `UTF-8`. This caused international characters with accents or special symbols to be corrupted when parsed and passed into `ReportGenerator.java`, resulting in the `test.sh` failure.

I updated `CsvReader.java` to use `StandardCharsets.UTF_8` instead and verified the fix by successfully running `test.sh`. All test cases checking for non-ASCII characters such as "Renée Duböis", "Hans Müller", and "København" now pass correctly.
